_note: The people published on /people/: ids from conferences/people.json (ai.engineer speaker slugs), in two groups, proposed by rule and approved by hand. Both groups need a technical role (engineer, researcher, scientist, technical staff, CTO, founding or co-founder, maintainer), a GitHub link and a talk since 2025; developer relations, evangelists, curators, investors, product, marketing, managers and authors are left out, because the page is about who builds. 'builders': three or more talks or two editions, at most two per organisation. 'quiet': one edition and at most two talks, one per organisation, most recent first: people who build more than they speak. Remove an id to unpublish; add one to publish.
